savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Pursuant to section 202(a) of the NEA (50 U.S.C. 1622(a)), termination of the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12722 shall not affect any action taken or proceeding pending but not finally concluded or determined as of the effective date of this order, any action or proceeding based on any act committed prior to such date, or any rights or duties that matured or penalties that were incurred prior to such date.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: A statutory savings clause for the termination of the Iraq emergency. The preamble revokes EO 12722, 12724, 12734, 12743, 12751 and 12817 as 'based on that national emergency', so the clause reaches actions taken and rights or duties matured under EO 12734 before the effective date.

savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Pursuant to section 207(a) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1706(a)), and subject to such regulations, orders, directives, or licenses as may be issued pursuant to this order, I hereby determine that the continuation of prohibitions with regard to transactions involving property blocked pursuant to Executive Orders 12722 or 12724 that continues to be blocked as of the effective date of this order is necessary on account of claims involving Iraq.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Continues the blocking of property blocked under EO 12722 and 12724 only; EO 12734 blocked nothing.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 10: 'This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July 30, 2004.' The signing date is July 29, 2004. The preamble revocation of EO 12734 is therefore effective 2004-07-30, not the signing date (printed 69 FR 46055-46057, July 30, 2004).

targets_in_batch_03.EO:12734: preamble ('revoke that Executive Order and Executive Order 12724 ..., Executive Order 12734 of November 14, 1990, ... that are based on that national emergency')

conclusion: EO 13350 (signed 2004-07-29, 69 FR 46055, PDF pages 1-13, read once in full; PDF pages 4-13 are images of the Annex) terminates the national emergency declared in EO 12722 (Iraq, 1990), revokes EO 12722, 12724, 12734, 12743, 12751 and 12817 as based on it, amends EO 13290 and EO 13315, and sets up new blocking and cultural-property measures under the 2003 emergency (secs. 2-8). Sec. 1 saves, under NEA sec. 202(a), every action taken, pending proceeding, matured right or duty and incurred penalty as of the effective date, and continues blocking of property blocked under EO 12722 and 12724. Sec. 9 disclaims private rights. Sec. 10 sets the effective moment at 12:01 a.m. EDT July 30, 2004.
